title: Systems and methods for federated learning

pse.problem: Current federated learning systems do not validate local data on a client device prior to training a local model, which may result in using inaccurate training data.
pse.solution_function: The system validates local training data on the client device by comparing it with external datasets locally and externally to ensure the accuracy of the training data.
pse.solution_structure: The system includes metadata from an external source for corroborating and validating local training data on the client device.
pse.solution_implementation: The system identifies relevant portions of a dataset to prompt extraction of de-identified metadata from the client device corresponding to the external database, then compares the de-identified metadata with the external data to ensure the accuracy of the training data on the client device.
pse.effect: The system improves the accuracy of the model by preventing training a local model using inaccurate training data in a federated learning environment.
